name: Simple IVR Menu
description: A basic IVR menu with Press 1 for Sales, Press 2 for Support

welcome.name: Welcome Message
welcome.text: Welcome to ACME Corporation. Please listen carefully as our menu options have changed.

prompt.text: Press 1 for Sales. Press 2 for Support. Press 3 to hear our business hours.

sales.name: Transfer to Sales
sales.text: Please hold while we transfer you to our sales department.

support.name: Transfer to Support
support.text: Connecting you to technical support. One moment please.

business_hours.name: Business Hours Message
business_hours.text: Our business hours are Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM Eastern Time. We are closed on weekends and major holidays.

invalid_choice.name: Invalid Choice
invalid_choice.text: I'm sorry, that is not a valid option. Please try again.

timeout.name: Timeout Message
timeout.text: I didn't receive your selection. Please try again.

sales_voicemail.name: Sales Voicemail
sales_voicemail.text: All of our sales representatives are currently assisting other customers. Please leave a message after the tone, and we will return your call shortly.

sales_busy.name: Sales Busy
sales_busy.text: Our sales queue is currently full. Please try again later or visit our website at acme dot com.

support_voicemail.name: Support Voicemail
support_voicemail.text: All support agents are currently busy. Please leave a detailed message including your name, phone number, and issue, and we will get back to you as soon as possible.

support_busy.name: Support Busy
support_busy.text: Our support queue is at capacity. For immediate assistance, please check our knowledge base at support dot acme dot com.

goodbye.name: Goodbye
goodbye.text: Thank you for calling ACME Corporation. Goodbye.
